items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Like they say, you know, this guy with the twist -- what's his name? [INTERVIEWER] Chubby Checker, originally.

ctx.x: Yes. We had a great show down at Connie's Inn, incidentally, and I would like to make mention of the fact there was a great dancer that I remember called Earl "Snakehips" Tucker. He was the one that invented that when you dance, you know, the snakehips. But he was quite famous. Like they say, you know, this guy with the twist -- what's his name?
Earl Tucker was the dancer that way. Snakehips.
